settled.point: How readouts sit on the page: the bearer reads his own sheet in his Crystal, instruments print everyone else's, figures inline with set-off blocks only at milestones, body before number.
settled.why_not_asked: Style law, ruled 2026-10-03; the questions here ask only what the card records.

settled.point: Growth that earns a readout: a Level gained with its points, a Stage, a new Trait, Wellspring contact.
settled.why_not_asked: Style law, ruled 2026-10-03; CH5 asks only who spends the points.

settled.point: Numbers move only for a cause the reader saw; a breakthrough lands inside its Catalyst crisis; a new Stage is confirmed at a public re-assay; each chapter closes with a changes block.
settled.why_not_asked: Style law, ruled 2026-10-03; CH14 to CH17 build the card's records and the training yield on them.

settled.point: Ranked practitioners speak exact figures and argue builds; commoners round.
settled.why_not_asked: Style law, ruled 2026-10-03.

settled.point: Progression models (Cradle, Reverend Insanity, Solo Leveling, The Wandering Inn beside Unbound) and the licensed arc shapes (tournament, Well delve, training montage, episodic jobs).
settled.why_not_asked: Style law, ruled 2026-10-03; the questions here ask what a card records of an arc and what training pays, never an arc's shape.

settled.point: Guild commendations carry legal and social weight and no stat effect; a Third Name coined for your character sticks only if you keep it.
settled.why_not_asked: Style law, and R50-21 stands.

settled.point: Comic names: the norm among commons and soldiers, who may carry one, how they are built and grown, a bank per culture, walk-ons named only in a mouth, the joke turning to grief at a bad death, and full comic beats only for carded comic voices.
settled.why_not_asked: The style law's naming and humour sections, ruled 2026-10-03; CH11 asks only how the card records it.

settled.point: Your PC Sodoku Moto and the other creators' characters are never thought or voiced for, never carry a comic name, and Sonzai gets a record card only.
settled.why_not_asked: Standing law; CH4, CH5 and CH17 ask how far your characters' builds and gates are yours.

settled.point: A rival recurs only by a mercy paid for on the Ledger.
settled.why_not_asked: CB5 of the style law; CH12 asks only how a rival grows between meetings.

settled.point: Character first: refusal, wound and conviction produce the phenomenon, and the Codex files it afterward.
settled.why_not_asked: Standing law; CH10 asks only which of the three get card fields.

settled.point: Every major card carries the fixed voice block; gloss rights is a card field; your play beats your character's card.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled; CH8 asks only about new slots.

settled.point: Every card carries a pronunciation line and a dated As Of line; the header describes a stated moment and the Lore carries later events, deaths included.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled; the sweep applies them where missing.

settled.point: A new person is a role until they speak twice or matter.
settled.why_not_asked: Naming law 2026-09-26; CH2 builds the rungs above it.

settled.point: The stat model: points buy Sub-Stats only, a Primary is the total of its eight and its Grade the mean, the Stage's Max Grade letter caps allocation, Pools follow Part Three's allotment with Stage I counting, and older sheets are re-costed to it.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled; CH4 asks only how much of it a card shows.

settled.point: Never invent a number; Fracture of Worlds, then the Stat Sheet workbook, then the card; an estimate is printed, marked, and canon on use until a source figure beats it.
settled.why_not_asked: Standing law; CH7 asks only the card's mark. The wotr-stat-line skill's different order is a text fix.

settled.point: Stage names come from Fracture of Worlds (Ignition, Hold, Temper and Surge are dead); the Tier of Standing replaces the lettered Coherence Band; Tiers by name only, Stage and Band numerals beside their names.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled; the sweep (ME2) applies them, Cozbi's 'Tier of Standing 8' header included.

settled.point: Sodoku's and Krothar's Levels past their Band gates stand as outliers with standing Residual Strain.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled 2026-09-26 (C-041); CH6 asks only about the four Kharven cards never put.

settled.point: Card fields the combat law already requires: each card names its grammar, a filled Readiness (casting-time) figure governs a casting race, a vow's output figure sits on its card, fusion exists only as a carded Synergia (joint-working) technique, alchemists may take a 'reads first' line.
settled.why_not_asked: Combat law, ruled 2026-10-04; how a technique entry carries them is asked in the Keystones and Techniques sections.

settled.point: An item carries its ladder rung and gets one card on the page; a technique entry says what an ability is, never how to use it.
settled.why_not_asked: Ability law 2026-09-26 and the style law; no question here reopens them.

settled.point: Archived scenes stay untouched and are precedent for events, not prose; commoners hold practitioners in awe, and folk beliefs about magic go uncorrected.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled; CH13 leans on them.

settled.point: Boundary: how downtime runs, whether NPCs act on their wants off the page, and what makes a Front tick belong to the table questionnaire.
settled.why_not_asked: Asked there (WD1 on what moves a Front, WD7 on NPCs off the page, WD8 on downtime); this questionnaire keeps card content, the yield of training (CH15) and how a rival's numbers climb (CH12).

settled.point: Fix, not ask: the converter's 'pending Isaac' placeholders, its Design Chain brief and Coherence Band; create_character's 'marked pending'; the roster schema's missing body and stat-line fields; Earth day names in roster entries; duplicated header blocks.
settled.why_not_asked: Stale text against live law; corrected in the build (ME1), not put to you.

settled.point: Converted and old sheets are re-costed by scaling the source's own allocation to Part Three's current allotment on the canon model, Grade letters re-derived; fresh derivation is not the method.
settled.why_not_asked: Ruled, so no question offers fresh derivation; CH4 asks only how unset Sub-Stats are filled inside the re-costed totals, and CH13 only about feats the new numbers cannot carry.

settled.point: The card sweep owes, under live law: FOW Stage names, Büri forms (Yoko's card body still says Temür), Sub-Stat names retired by Part Twelve's merge, Tiers by name, every Pool re-costed, and reserves set by the Level law.
settled.why_not_asked: Owed already; ME2 asks only what joins it.

settled.point: Every lie leaves a catchable tell (a body tell, a fact that does not fit, or a detail changed later), and NPCs lie often.
settled.why_not_asked: Live; CH8 asks only whether a card records its bearer's body tell.

settled.point: Each practitioner chants in his own tongue; learned cultures carry a learned tongue (Latin for the Accord, hanmun, kanbun, wenyan).
settled.why_not_asked: Live; CH8 asks only whether the card gets a slot that records which tongue.

settled.point: Comic voices and double acts are named on their cards, and only they play full comic beats.
settled.why_not_asked: Style law; CH11's samples carry the field.

settled.point: Hollow is 'the unawakened baseline' (Part Four), and Orin Farrant's card, under R67-2, carries no Level, Stage, Band or Pool; Tabitha Hallenfeld's and Dunstan the Brine's cards print 'Stage 0' and 'Band 0', which no Fracture of Worlds table holds.
settled.why_not_asked: Two cards against Fracture of Worlds and a ruled card: a CONFLICTS.md row for the docket and the sweep's cross-read (ME2 B), not a question.

settled.point: Who can hide his rank is the Suppression Sub-Stat, 'a skill that tires the user for as long as it is held' (Part Twelve), and how it shows is R71-43; the suppression profile the character-sheet reference still asks for came from R7-7, which fell with Pack Seven.
settled.why_not_asked: Stat and page are ruled; the reference's 'pitch one, label it' line is stale text for ME1, not a question.
